blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— Sen. Bam Aquino defended the government’s research on how to make carabao mangoes suited for space missions after Sen. Imee Marcos questioned the initiative during a budget hearing in the Senate Wednesday. Marcos raised the issue after Aquino presented the proposed P1.095 billion budget of the Philippine Space Agency for 2027. “What about the news regarding Philippine Carabao mangoes for space missions? We’re all completely befuddled by these programs of the Philippine Space Agency,” she said.
